name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Bracers
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Bracers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe. Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes. Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.
Bring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hunt those in Zul'Gurub that would possess the Paragons of Power, friend. They are your prey; they possess that which we both must have.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes... I need no vision to sense the presence of the Paragons of Power. Your success in Zul'Gurub has impressed many among the tribe. We not only consider you to be a friend of the Zandalar, but also consider you worthy enough to possess the predator's bracers - powerful items, and a symbol of what it means to be a predator. Well done, friend.
